## Video-Catcher 0.1.1: the first fixes

What came up when the window was used for the first time.

- **New:** a name of your own for one download. After "Look up", the field "Name for this download" holds the name the pattern gives; change it and only this video gets the new name. The ending (.mp4, .mkv ...) is added by itself.
- **Fixed:** the progress bar stayed empty (the percent number was right).
- **Fixed:** in the download list, the title sat at the right edge and the buttons next to the number. Now the title is next to the number and the buttons are on the right.
- **Fixed:** clicking "Stop" while a download was running fast could do nothing: the row was drawn anew four times a second. Now only the numbers change.
- **Fixed:** "Will be saved as" was empty at the start and after adding a download.
- **Fixed:** the activity log shows its lines in the language of the window, also after switching, and every line has its time. The first line no longer has a wide gap.
- **Fixed:** what a download is doing right now ("downloading", "joining picture and sound" ...) is shown in German too.

Install: download `VideoCatcher.exe` (or `VideoCatcher-arm64.exe` for Windows on ARM) and start it. Your settings and the download list are kept.

The files are not digitally signed yet; Windows SmartScreen may warn. Every file is built by GitHub Actions from this repository, and `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists their checksums.
